summary: Magma Chamber (2010 5v5 'Caldera' concept, Concept 04 layout): a lens-shaped platform over the abyss, frost side (west, blue) and volcanic side (east, red) with the same mirrored layout: top and bottom lanes along the rim and a straight mid, 3 turrets per lane, inhibitors, nexus turrets, a north-south spine joining the Baron pit, the centre and the Dragon pit, six camps per side in clearings off the lanes, teleport pads, icy pools in the west and lava pools in the east, health relics on the rim platforms. Walls are built from Season 1 Crystal Scar / Twisted Treeline scenery (rock formations, frozen trees in the west, charred trees in the east, cliff stones on the rim) with runestone decals and stone torches along the lanes.
